description: Every common notation symbol and score layout, each item with an exact MusicXML 4.0 truth generated from the same model as its LilyPond 2.24 engraving, an undamaged raster (clean.pdf), a typical scan (scan.pdf) and a heavily damaged scan (scan-severe.pdf). All CC0.

families.description: Note values breve-64th, dots and double dots, chords up to 6 notes, beams (groups, hooks, over rests), flags, stems, ledger lines to 5 above/below, grace notes (slashed, beamed, chords), cue notes, tremolos.

Every rest value breve-64th, dotted rests, whole-bar rests in simple and compound meters, multi-bar rests (H-bar and old-style symbols), rests in two-voice staves, piano and quartet, rests inside tuplets and beams.
All 8 clefs and clef changes, all 15 major and 15 minor key signatures and key changes, every accidental incl. double sharps/flats and courtesy accidentals, 8va/8vb/15ma lines vs ledger lines.
All simple, compound and irregular meters, C and cut time, meter changes, pickups, triplets to septuplets, duplets/quadruplets, nested tuplets, ties across barlines, systems and pages.
Articulations, ornaments, fermatas, breath marks, every dynamic and hairpin, pedal, arpeggios, fingering, tempo/metronome marks, text expressions, rehearsal marks, chord symbols.
Double and final barlines, repeats, 1st/2nd/3rd endings, segno/coda/D.S./D.C./Fine, system and page breaks, multi-page scores up to 12 pages.
Lyric elisions (two syllables on one note), non-ASCII lyrics in four languages (German, French, Spanish, Czech), numbered multi-verse lyrics, hyphens, extenders, melismas.
One exemplar per score layout: melody, song, piano, voice+piano, five choir layouts, choir+piano, organ, quartet, orchestra, lead sheet, hymnal, divisi, cross-staff, two voices on one staff.
Percussion layout (percussion-none): one-line snare staff and 5-line drum set (percussion clef, x noteheads, two voices) beside a pitched melody.
Speed/memory sets: one hymn page and one piano page at 100-600 dpi and on Letter/A4/A3, and a piano book of 1, 5, 10, 20 and 40 pages (identical pages across books).
